name: tia_connect_to_subnet
description: Connect a device's network interface node to a subnet (Node.ConnectToSubnet).

device_name.description: Exact device (station) name as listed by tia_list_devices, e.g. 'PLC_1' or 'ACS480_1'.

interface_path.description: Device-item path of the network interface; omit when the device has only one Ethernet interface.
